request: Build a small Jac web app for a personal task board. A task has a title, a priority (low, medium or high), a due date and a status (todo, in progress or done). The user can add tasks, move a task to another status, delete it, and see the board grouped by status with high-priority tasks first in each group. Keep the task rules in a reusable service.
acceptance: A task needs a non-empty title and one of the three priorities; anything else is rejected.
Moving a task changes only its status.
Within each status group, tasks are ordered high, medium, low, then by due date.
constraints: Use Jac 0.36.1 and a fullstack Jac app.
Keep the logic deterministic and independent of external APIs.

source.note: Requirements paraphrased in English from the repository README/description; no code copied.
